excludedProperties.name: DeviceEnrollmentConfigurationType
excludedProperties.note: The vendor enum spans every deviceEnrollmentConfiguration subtype while this resource covers only deviceEnrollmentPlatformRestrictionConfiguration and deviceEnrollmentPlatformRestrictionsConfiguration. The other members belong to IntuneDeviceEnrollmentLimitRestriction, IntuneDeviceEnrollmentStatusPageWindows10, IntuneWindowsHelloForBusinessGlobalPolicy and IntuneWindowsBackupForOrganizationConfiguration. A wider ValidateSet would accept a value that no Set branch handles.

excludedProperties.name: PlatformType
excludedProperties.note: Only the singular deviceEnrollmentPlatformRestrictionConfiguration subtype carries it. The resource derives it from whichever platform restriction property is populated and adds it to the request body itself.

excludedProperties.name: PlatformRestriction
excludedProperties.note: The payload of the singular subtype. Get projects it onto the matching platform restriction property and Set renames the chosen one back, which already reaches all six deviceEnrollmentPlatformRestriction members.

description: This resource configures the Intune device platform enrollment restrictions.
